plan.title: Auction QCS Line and Vendor Ranks

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow for an auction.
Configure the event with an auction stage.
Work on the auction stage before configuring its template and items.
Apply the auction pricing template so the comparison sheet can be populated.
Create multiple line items so ranking can be checked per line.
Commit a valid auction schedule before publishing.
Invite several vendors so the QCS has multiple bidder columns and ranks to compare.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the first invited vendor submit a bid.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Have a second invited vendor submit a bid for comparison.
Confirm the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's QCS comparison after multiple bids are present.
Verify that the QCS contains a real vendor column for each bidder.
Assert that ranks are assigned at line-item level and follow the auction amounts across the bidder columns.
